task: Independent novelty and causal-identification audit of the post-retrieval VMem memory consumer, with no model execution and no main-ledger mutation.
skills_applied: Supervisor-Skills handbook idea-generation rules carried through the frozen S41 boundary
mathematical_findings: The arithmetic mean is invariant to source assignment permutations and has a (K-1)d-dimensional linear nullspace for K>1.
The VMem CLIP context has key length one per camera; the softmax attention weight over that key is one for every query, so this branch has no query-dependent source or region address space.
These are branch-level capacity facts, not evidence of total-model failure because per-frame latents, masks and Plucker coordinates remain on parallel paths.
next_gate: After a SHA-verified and readback-verified real S40 baseline exists, run only A0 original mean, A0R exact replay and A1 zero-CLIP. Do not implement a new attention, router or conflict gate before this influence gate passes.
limitations: The literature search was targeted rather than exhaustive.
No empirical conclusion about VMem output influence, harmful averaging, regional locality or selective abstention was produced.
